final: WITH group_avgs AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.death_country, ''), '') AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.death_country, ''), '')) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM group_avgs) AS distance_from_group_average FROM group_avgs ORDER BY death_country
